tasks.dev: env LAUFEY_APP_ID=net.thedoctorttv.ytmusicdesktop LAUFEY_APP_NAME='YouTube Music Desktop' LAUFEY_APP_ICON=$PWD/icons/youtubemusic.png XDG_DATA_HOME=$HOME/.local/share/net.thedoctorttv.ytmusicdesktop/data XDG_CACHE_HOME=$HOME/.cache/net.thedoctorttv.ytmusicdesktop XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/.config/net.thedoctorttv.ytmusicdesktop GDK_BACKEND=wayland,x11 __NV_DISABLE_EXPLICIT_SYNC=1 deno desktop --exclude-unused-npm --exclude node_modules --icon ./icons/youtubemusic.png --allow-net=127.0.0.1,music.youtube.com,www.youtube.com,accounts.google.com,google.com,gstatic.com,googleusercontent.com,ytimg.com --hmr main.ts
tasks.dev:native: env LAUFEY_APP_ID=net.thedoctorttv.ytmusicdesktop.native LAUFEY_APP_NAME='YouTube Music Desktop Native' LAUFEY_APP_ICON=$PWD/icons/youtubemusic.png XDG_DATA_HOME=$HOME/.local/share/net.thedoctorttv.ytmusicdesktop.native/data XDG_CACHE_HOME=$HOME/.cache/net.thedoctorttv.ytmusicdesktop.native XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/.config/net.thedoctorttv.ytmusicdesktop.native GDK_BACKEND=wayland,x11 __NV_DISABLE_EXPLICIT_SYNC=1 deno desktop --config ./deno.native.json --exclude-unused-npm --exclude node_modules --icon ./icons/youtubemusic.png --allow-net=127.0.0.1,music.youtube.com,www.youtube.com,accounts.google.com,google.com,gstatic.com,googleusercontent.com,ytimg.com --hmr main_native.ts
tasks.check: deno check --desktop main.ts main_native.ts && deno check scripts/preview.ts
